reason: E2 and E3 show that interphase boundaries and deformation twinning enhance work hardening in a dual-phase HEA, but only under monotonic loading at 293K/77K, not creep. E1 and E4 do not address boundary-mediated creep resistance, and E5 discusses twin boundary migration in a different context. No cited evidence directly supports the key premise that interphase/twin boundaries reduce steady-state creep rates under sustained high-temperature loading.
